mapper.select: SELECT id, session_id, seq, direction, node_id, option_id, content, content_ciphertext, content_key_id, content_encryption_version, payload::text AS payload, latency_ms, created_at FROM chat_message WHERE session_id = #{sessionId}::uuid ORDER BY seq, id

SELECT m.id, m.session_id, m.seq, m.direction, m.node_id, m.option_id, m.content, m.content_ciphertext, m.content_key_id, m.content_encryption_version, m.payload::text AS payload, m.latency_ms, m.created_at, fb.rating AS feedback_rating, fb.comment AS feedback_comment, fb.comment_ciphertext AS feedback_comment_ciphertext, fb.comment_key_id AS feedback_comment_key_id, fb.comment_encryption_version AS feedback_comment_encryption_version FROM chat_message m LEFT JOIN chat_feedback fb ON fb.message_id = m.id WHERE m.session_id = #{sessionId}::uuid ORDER BY m.seq, m.id

SELECT id, session_id, seq, direction, node_id, option_id, content, content_ciphertext, content_key_id, content_encryption_version, payload::text AS payload, latency_ms, created_at FROM chat_message WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(seq), 0) + 1 FROM chat_message WHERE session_id = #{sessionId}::uuid

SELECT id, content AS plaintext, content_ciphertext AS ciphertext, content_key_id AS key_id FROM chat_message WHERE content_ciphertext IS NULL AND content IS NOT NULL AND content != '' AND content != '[encrypted]' ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT id, content AS plaintext, content_ciphertext AS ciphertext, content_key_id AS key_id FROM chat_message WHERE content_ciphertext IS NOT NULL AND content_key_id IS NOT NULL AND content_key_id != #{activeKeyId} ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}
